C0816.title: Can You Really Get Away After Deleting a Database? - Mo Tianlun
C0816.summary: Public reports document multiple cases in which employees were sentenced for malicious database deletion. In February 2020, Weimob employee He deleted SaaS business data, affecting more than three million merchants and causing an outage that lasted eight days and fourteen hours; he was sentenced to six years in prison for sabotaging a computer information system. In June 2018, former Lianjia database administrator Han Bing deleted financial system data and applications, making the system inaccessible and causing 180,000 yuan in recovery losses; he was sentenced to seven years in prison.
